title: Launch Vehicle Technology
definition: Launch vehicle technology encompasses the engineering systems, propulsion mechanisms, and guidance frameworks utilized to propel payloads—such as satellites and crewed spacecraft—from Earth's surface into designated orbits against gravitational forces.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology (GS Paper III) covering space missions, indigenous capabilities, commercial space policy, and strategic dual-use aerospace technologies.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Launch Vehicle Technology.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic physics of motion and gravity
Understanding of orbital mechanics (LEO, MEO, GEO)
